method: Smooth thin-plate inverse mapping of body landmarks; locally fit measured front piping to smooth waist paths with fixed outer torso; fit continuous side contours; sample original master through composed coordinates on the shared 240 x 320 canvas.

male.note: Guardian revision 2: single gold border, one chevron per panel, independently measured body geometry and local piping controls. Torso/sleeves stay fixed outside the trim adjustment.

front_fit.description: Measured pre-contour gold edges to smooth monotone waist paths. Outer torso and sleeves stay pinned at x90/150; gold fill is 1.85 px between blends. Source coordinates, not colors, are remapped.

contour_fit.input_space: smooth body-fit canvas before contour correction
